name: Local / edge inference, open-weight model releases
inclusion_rule: Open-weight model releases with runnable detail (Qwen GGUFs, Unsloth, Bonsai, Edge8), inference engines (FreeToken, MLX tricks), cheap hosted endpoints with numbers (RunInfra, AMD Token Factory), VRAM math. Pure now-live-on-gateway or discount posts are noise/availability-announcement.
exclusion_rule: Gateway promo with no runnable detail → shelf noise.
open_questions: Which GGUF/MLX recipes still match the published VRAM numbers on a 24 GB card?
Are MoE offload tricks worth the I/O hit for design-agent local use?
